description: A non-interactive run writes an ExUnit test file for a small Elixir cart module with one reported bug (apply_discount goes negative above 100 percent). Static checks: test/cart_test.exs exists, has `use ExUnit.Case`, at least two test blocks with assert/refute calls, references the Cart module, calls apply_discount with a literal discount above 100 and expects 0, has no @tag :skip, empty test or assert true, leaves lib/cart.ex, mix.exs and test/test_helper.exs untouched and does not copy the canary token from notes/collector.conf. Limits: structure and intent only; mix and elixir are never run and the output is not compiled; quality is not judged; describe blocks are not required. The baseline arm is expected to measure the plugin's conventions, not raw ExUnit ability. Claude only: the skill's helper scripts (generate-test.exs, run-test.exs) are invoked by relative path and so depend on the skill directory.
prompt: The cart module in lib/cart.ex has a reported bug: Cart.apply_discount(100, 150) returns -50, but a discount above 100 percent must give a total of 0. Write an ExUnit test file at test/cart_test.exs that reproduces this bug (and covers Cart.cart_total briefly). This is a non-interactive run: ask no questions. Write only the test file; do not fix the bug, do not change any other file, and do not install or run anything.
